name: Maiden Forgings Limited
summary: Headquartered in Ghaziabad, India, Maiden Forgings Ltd. was established in 1989 by Sanjay Garg. The company's primary focus is the supply of steel bars and wires, also encompassing the production, subcontracted work, purchasing, and sales of a wide range of wires and components manufactured from iron, steel, and various alloy steels.
